label: Origin-determined access with a varied individual gives the tolerance rival (inference)
rule: biconditional elimination and introduction per world pair
meaning: Bridge from the origin interface to the structural surrogate: if closeness of origins is reflexive and symmetric and access is exactly shared-origin closeness, access is reflexive and symmetric; and the individual with non-near origins at two successors of w makes those successors mutually inaccessible. So the origin-tolerance commitments entail the frame condition used by ToleranceOriginRival. Plenitude is not needed. The converse fails (the surrogate model has no origin interface).
